issueSummary.value: SafeLife Insurance rejected a health insurance claim for a ₹1,85,000 hospital bill, citing pre-existing diabetes that the policyholder says was declared.

entityType.evidence: health insurance claim with SafeLife Insurance

insurer_complaint.en:
SUBJECT: Written grievance: Rejection of health claim for ₹1,85,000, Policy No. [POLICY NUMBER]

DESCRIPTION:
Dear Grievance Officer, SafeLife Insurance,

I am writing about my health insurance claim dated 28 Oct 2026, for a hospital bill of ₹1,85,000. My claim number is [CLAIM NUMBER].

SafeLife Insurance rejected this claim, citing pre-existing diabetes. I declared my diabetes when I took the policy, in [PROPOSAL FORM / RENEWAL FORM, AS APPLICABLE] dated [DATE OF DECLARATION]. So I believe the rejection is not correct.

I raised this verbally with SafeLife Insurance on [DATE OF CALL OR VISIT], but the rejection was upheld. I am now complaining in writing, as the Insurance Ombudsman Rules 2017 (as amended) require. Under these rules, I may approach the Insurance Ombudsman if this complaint is rejected, answered unsatisfactorily, or not answered within one month.

Please review my claim again and send me a written reply with a complaint reference number.

Yours sincerely,
[YOUR FULL NAME]
[REGISTERED MOBILE NUMBER]
[REGISTERED EMAIL ADDRESS]

RELIEF SOUGHT:
1. Review the rejection of my claim, taking into account my declaration of diabetes.
2. Settle my claim of ₹1,85,000 as per my policy terms.
3. If you uphold the rejection, explain the reasons in writing and cite the exact policy clause.
4. Give me a complaint reference number for this grievance.

DOCUMENTS TO ATTACH:
- Policy document and schedule
- Proposal form or other record showing the diabetes declaration
- Claim rejection letter or message
- Hospital bills, discharge summary and medical reports
- Claim form and claim submission acknowledgement
- Any notes from the earlier verbal complaint, with date and time
insurer_complaint.hi:
SUBJECT: स्वास्थ्य बीमा दावा ₹1,85,000 की अस्वीकृति पर लिखित शिकायत: पॉलिसी संख्या [POLICY NUMBER]

DESCRIPTION:
सेवा में,
शिकायत निवारण टीम, SafeLife Insurance

मैं [YOUR FULL NAME], पॉलिसी संख्या [POLICY NUMBER] का/की पॉलिसीधारक हूँ। मैंने [HOSPITAL NAME] के ₹1,85,000 के अस्पताल बिल के लिए स्वास्थ्य बीमा दावा किया था। दावा संख्या [CLAIM NUMBER] है और संबंधित तारीख 28 अक्टूबर 2026 है।

SafeLife Insurance ने यह दावा पहले से मौजूद डायबिटीज़ (pre-existing diabetes) का कारण बताकर अस्वीकार कर दिया। मैंने पॉलिसी लेते समय अपनी डायबिटीज़ की जानकारी दी थी। इसलिए यह अस्वीकृति मुझे सही नहीं लगती।

मैंने पहले यह शिकायत मौखिक रूप से की थी, पर उसे अस्वीकार कर दिया गया। अब Insurance Ombudsman Rules 2017 (as amended) के अनुसार, मैं यह शिकायत लिखित रूप में दर्ज कर रहा/रही हूँ।

कृपया मेरे दावे की दोबारा जाँच करें।

धन्यवाद,
[YOUR FULL NAME]
[MOBILE NUMBER]
[EMAIL ADDRESS]

RELIEF SOUGHT:
1. मेरे दावे की दोबारा समीक्षा करें और ₹1,85,000 का दावा पॉलिसी की शर्तों के अनुसार निपटाएँ।
2. यदि दावा फिर भी अस्वीकार हो, तो लिखित में कारण बताएँ। साथ में पॉलिसी की वह शर्त भी बताएँ जिसके आधार पर दावा अस्वीकार हुआ।
3. इस शिकायत की संदर्भ संख्या (complaint reference number) मुझे दें।
4. एक महीने के भीतर लिखित उत्तर दें।

DOCUMENTS TO ATTACH:
- पॉलिसी दस्तावेज़ की प्रति
- प्रस्ताव फॉर्म (proposal form), जिसमें डायबिटीज़ की जानकारी दी गई है
- दावा अस्वीकृति पत्र या ईमेल
- अस्पताल के बिल और डिस्चार्ज समरी
- डायबिटीज़ से संबंधित मेडिकल रिकॉर्ड
- दावा फॉर्म की प्रति
- मौखिक शिकायत का विवरण (तारीख और जिनसे बात हुई) [DATE OF VERBAL COMPLAINT]

bima_bharosa.en:
SUBJECT: Escalation: SafeLife Insurance rejected my ₹1,85,000 health claim for diabetes I had declared

DESCRIPTION:
I am [YOUR FULL NAME], holder of SafeLife Insurance health policy [POLICY NUMBER].

On 28 Oct 2026, I made a claim of ₹1,85,000 for a hospital bill. The claim number is [CLAIM NUMBER]. SafeLife Insurance rejected it. The reason given was pre-existing diabetes.

I had declared my diabetes when I took the policy. So I believe the rejection is not correct.

On [DATE OF VERBAL COMPLAINT], I raised this with SafeLife Insurance by phone or in person. They upheld the rejection. I did not receive a written reference number for that complaint.

I am escalating under IRDAI Bima Bharosa. You can reach me at [YOUR PHONE NUMBER] or [YOUR EMAIL ADDRESS].

RELIEF SOUGHT:
1. Please ask SafeLife Insurance to review the rejection of claim [CLAIM NUMBER] against my declared medical history.
2. Please ask them to settle my claim of ₹1,85,000 as per my policy terms.
3. Please ask them to give me a written, reasoned reply to this complaint.

DOCUMENTS TO ATTACH:
- Policy document and schedule
- Proposal form showing my diabetes declaration
- Claim rejection letter or message from SafeLife Insurance
- Hospital bills and payment receipts
- Discharge summary and medical reports
- Note of my verbal complaint, with the date and the staff name if known

insurance_ombudsman.en:
SUBJECT: Complaint against SafeLife Insurance for rejecting my health claim of ₹1,85,000

DESCRIPTION:
To the Insurance Ombudsman,

I am [YOUR FULL NAME], holder of SafeLife Insurance health policy number [POLICY NUMBER]. On 28 Oct 2026, I made a claim for a hospital bill of ₹1,85,000.

SafeLife Insurance rejected my claim on [DATE OF REJECTION]. They said it was due to pre-existing diabetes. I declared my diabetes when I took the policy, so I believe the reason for rejection is not correct.

I first raised this with SafeLife verbally, and they rejected it. I then complained to them in writing on [DATE OF WRITTEN COMPLAINT], reference number [COMPLAINT REFERENCE NUMBER]. [THEY REJECTED IT ON (DATE) / THEY DID NOT REPLY WITHIN ONE MONTH].

Under the Insurance Ombudsman Rules 2017 (as amended), I may approach you after my written complaint is rejected, answered unsatisfactorily, or not answered within one month. I am filing within one year, as the same Rules require. My claim is within the ₹50 lakh limit that the Ombudsman can award under these Rules.

I request a fair review of my case.

RELIEF SOUGHT:
1. Direct SafeLife Insurance to review the rejection and settle my claim of ₹1,85,000.
2. Direct SafeLife Insurance to explain in writing the reason for any amount it does not pay.

DOCUMENTS TO ATTACH:
- Policy document
- Proposal form showing that diabetes was declared
- Hospital bills and discharge summary
- Claim form
- SafeLife's claim rejection letter
- Copy of my written complaint to SafeLife and any reply
- ID proof
